# Clock range breakout optional gates (Asia range colour breakout in the engine)

## Problem and scope

[HT-306](HT-306-gold-asia-range-colour-breakout-research.md) recorded the
XAUUSD Asia range colour breakout as WATCH. Its rule cannot run in the engine:
the v1 `clock range breakout` family ([HT-167](HT-167-dsl-clock-range-breakout.md))
has no range-width, prior-day-direction or cancel gate, only a percent stop,
and no target. The note lists the language changes needed (items 1-6 of
"Language changes needed"). This task implements them in the Go producer.

[HT-168](HT-168-dsl-clock-range-breakout-extras.md) holds unranked EA-parity
extras and asks for a separate semantic contract per item. This task is that
contract for the five items below. HT-168's other items (range size in points
or percent, trade caps, trailing, other target modes, DSL clocks, volume modes,
magnifier) stay there.

New opt-in phrases, all placement-time and causal:

1. Trading-day series from the route bars on the declared clock; a date whose
   bars span under four hours merges into the next date.
2. `range width at least <X> daily ATR <N>`.
3. `trade with prior day candle`.
4. `cancel when opposite side triggers first`.
5. `stop beyond opposite range edge`, and with it `target <N>R`.

Item 7 of the note (holiday early-close exit) is not included.

Outside this task: a strat release tag, the app pin bump (the app pin is
v0.30.0 and app PR #511 adopts v0.38), the app JavaScript runtime (the family
stays Go-only), strategy registration, `validate-strategy`, book membership and
forward testing.
